lines.zh: 我沿村道走，弩在背上一颠一颠。
lines.en: I walk the village road, crossbow bobbing on my back.

lines.zh: 靴子踩碎麦子，我不打算赔。
lines.en: My boots crush the wheat and I will not pay.

lines.zh: 每走七步，我停下来听一次。
lines.en: Every seven steps I stop and listen once.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡在墙后喘气，我绕开。
lines.en: An iron golem wheezes behind the wall; I go around.

lines.zh: 我踩着自家的菌毯往前走。
lines.en: I advance along the fungus carpet I grew myself.

lines.zh: 走到钟楼下面，我放轻脚步。
lines.en: Passing under the bell tower, I soften my step.

lines.zh: 装填杆咔一声，我照样走。
lines.en: The charging lever clicks and I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我的脚印里很快冒出白丝。
lines.en: White threads sprout quickly inside my footprints.

lines.zh: 前面有狗在叫，我换了方向。
lines.en: Dogs bark ahead, so I choose another direction.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，像领着一支队伍。
lines.en: I walk steadily, as if leading a whole column.

lines.zh: 村口的门开着，我当是邀请。
lines.en: The village gate stands open; I take it as an invitation.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过沟，弩身没有晃。
lines.en: I stride across the ditch without jarring the crossbow.

lines.zh: 我数着村里的炊烟，一共九处。
lines.en: I count the chimney smoke: nine columns in all.

lines.zh: 弩弦松着，那一箭我留着。
lines.en: The string stays slack; that bolt is saved.

lines.zh: 我在等感染体把路清出来。
lines.en: I wait for the infected to clear the road.

lines.zh: 风把麦香送进我的鼻腔。
lines.en: Wind carries the smell of wheat into my nostrils.

lines.zh: 我站着，像插在田里的一根旗。
lines.en: I stand like a banner planted in the field.

lines.zh: 菌斑缓慢地爬上我的指节。
lines.en: The fungal patches creep slowly over my knuckles.

lines.zh: 我听见地下有东西在回话。
lines.en: I hear something underground answering me.

lines.zh: 钟响了一声，我没有动。
lines.en: The bell rings once and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我把弩横在膝上擦了一遍。
lines.en: I lay the crossbow on my knee and wipe it down.

lines.zh: 头顶的乌鸦不敢落下来。
lines.en: The crows overhead do not dare land.

lines.zh: 我在算那支队伍还剩几个人。
lines.en: I am counting how many of the column remain.

lines.zh: 肩上的布条晃着，我懒得系紧。
lines.en: The rag on my shoulder flaps; I cannot be bothered to tie it.

lines.zh: 太阳晒在菌毯上，气味变甜。
lines.en: The sun warms the fungus mat and the smell turns sweet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，确认四面都安静。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly, checking that all sides are quiet.

lines.zh: 我把弩矢在指间转了一圈。
lines.en: I spin a bolt between my fingers.

lines.zh: 白丝在墙根慢慢爬高。
lines.en: The white threads climb slowly up the wall base.

lines.zh: 我在听村里还有几声狗叫。
lines.en: I'm counting how many dogs still bark.

lines.zh: 队伍的名字，我一个都不记得。
lines.en: The squad's names. I remember none of them.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，先量你的护甲厚度。
lines.en: I look up and measure the thickness of your armor first.

lines.zh: 你的手里有盾，我记下了。
lines.en: You carry a shield; I have noted that.

lines.zh: 我看你的时间比看别人久。
lines.en: I watch you longer than I watch anyone else.

lines.zh: 你身上没有菌斑，很干净。
lines.en: There is no fungus on you; you are clean.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的眼睛，弩抬半寸。
lines.en: I hold your eyes and lift the crossbow half an inch.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着别处的泥土。
lines.en: Your boots carry dirt from somewhere else.

lines.zh: 我认得你这种表情，是怕。
lines.en: I know that expression on your face: fear.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我就上前半步。
lines.en: You step back once and I step forward half.

lines.zh: 我把你从头看到脚，慢慢看。
lines.en: I look you over from head to foot, slowly.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，照亮我的轮廓。
lines.en: You raise a torch and light up my outline.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，喉咙里有低响。
lines.en: Something rumbles low in my throat while I watch you.

lines.zh: 你没有跑，这让我有点意外。
lines.en: You did not run, which surprises me a little.

lines.zh: 护甲替我挡了大半，剩下的记着。
lines.en: The armor took most of it; I remember the rest.

lines.zh: 你砍中肩缝，白丝立刻缠上去。
lines.en: You split my shoulder seam and white threads seal it.

lines.zh: 我退半步，弩仍稳稳指着你。
lines.en: I give half a step, crossbow still steady on you.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，只是让我更清醒。
lines.en: That did not hurt; it only sharpened me.

lines.zh: 血是灰的，落进泥里不见了。
lines.en: My blood is gray and vanishes into the mud.

lines.zh: 我咬紧牙，装填杆又扳了一次。
lines.en: I clench my teeth and crank the charging lever again.

lines.zh: 你打中的是队长留下的旧疤。
lines.en: You struck the old scar the captain left.

lines.zh: 我倒吸一口气，闻到自己腐味。
lines.en: I gasp and smell my own rot.

lines.zh: 护甲裂了，里面的菌丝挤出来。
lines.en: The plate cracks and fungal threads squeeze out.

lines.zh: 再来，我看你还能砍几下。
lines.en: Again; let us see how many more swings you have.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，我不吃那种东西。
lines.en: You hold out bread; I do not eat such things.

lines.zh: 你把箭递过来，我只收弩矢。
lines.en: You offer arrows; I only take crossbow bolts.

lines.zh: 你晃动铁锭，我的弩比嘴诚实。
lines.en: You wave iron; my crossbow is more honest than my mouth.

lines.zh: 我靠近一步，这不算投降。
lines.en: I come one step closer; this is not surrender.

lines.zh: 你手里没有我要的，除非是命。
lines.en: You hold nothing I want, except your life.

lines.zh: 我抬起弩，这就是我的回答。
lines.en: I raise the crossbow; that is my answer.

lines.zh: 你想喂我，我只想喂菌。
lines.en: You want to feed me; I only want to feed the fungus.

lines.zh: 那袋种子，你还是自己吃吧。
lines.en: That bag of seeds, you had better eat yourself.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻，然后走开。
lines.en: I lower my head, sniff, then walk away.

lines.zh: 你的好意我收下，人不收。
lines.en: I accept your kindness, not you.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，护甲发出闷响。
lines.en: You crash into me and my armor gives a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲把你的力道弹回去。
lines.en: My pauldron throws your force right back at you.

lines.zh: 贴得这么近，你听见菌丝在响。
lines.en: This close, you can hear my fungal threads creak.

lines.zh: 我被撞得偏了一步，随即站定。
lines.en: The shove turns me a step, then I plant myself.

lines.zh: 别挤，弩上了弦容易走火。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; a loaded crossbow goes off easily.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我当成开战的信号。
lines.en: You bump me, and I read it as a call to war.

lines.zh: 我用手肘抵住你的胸口。
lines.en: I brace my elbow against your chest.

lines.zh: 两个人卡在门口，你先退。
lines.en: We jam the doorway together; you back off first.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下一片灰白菌皮。
lines.en: A flake of gray-white fungus falls off me.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我闻到你呼吸的味道。
lines.en: The bump lets me smell your breath.

lines.zh: 我这种存在没有配偶，只有队伍。
lines.en: Things like me have no mates, only a column.

lines.zh: 菌丝把两个躯体缝在一起就够了。
lines.en: Fungal threads stitching two bodies is enough.

lines.zh: 交配是活人的事，我只散播感染。
lines.en: Mating is for the living; I spread infection.

lines.zh: 你想靠近，我只想把你变成同类。
lines.en: You want closeness; I want you made into kin.

lines.zh: 我的后代从别人的伤口里长出来。
lines.en: My offspring grow out of other people's wounds.

lines.zh: 队伍里不需要温柔，只需要队形。
lines.en: The column needs no tenderness, only formation.

lines.zh: 我把孢子撒在你脚边，你慢慢来。
lines.en: I scatter spores at your feet; take your time.

lines.zh: 繁衍对我而言是把村庄染成白色。
lines.en: For me, breeding means bleaching a village white.

lines.zh: 我摸弩的时间比摸任何东西都长。
lines.en: I touch my crossbow longer than anything else.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的菌认生。
lines.en: Do not come closer; my fungus is shy of strangers.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的弩矢，一支不浪费。
lines.en: I pick up fallen bolts and waste not one.

lines.zh: 地上那把剑，我拿去换菌毯。
lines.en: That sword on the ground will buy more fungus mat.

lines.zh: 我把头盔扣上，尺寸正合适。
lines.en: I pull the helmet on; it fits exactly.

lines.zh: 面包我丢了，种子我留着。
lines.en: The bread I toss; the seeds I keep.

lines.zh: 我拾起队长丢下的号角。
lines.en: I pick up the horn the captain dropped.

lines.zh: 这袋火药归我的召唤物。
lines.en: This bag of gunpowder belongs to my summons.

lines.zh: 我把盾扛上肩，走路更响了。
lines.en: I hoist the shield onto my shoulder and clank louder.

lines.zh: 铁片装进兜里，叮当一片。
lines.en: Iron scraps go in my pocket, jingling.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的弓，弦已经断了。
lines.en: I pick up your bow; the string is already snapped.

lines.zh: 我把它捡起来，只因为它挡路。
lines.en: I pick it up only because it blocks my path.

lines.zh: 看见你了，那条进度线开始走。
lines.en: I see you, and that advancement line starts ticking.

lines.zh: 聚落之祸，从你这一箭起头。
lines.en: Scourge of the settlement begins with this one bolt.

lines.zh: 我抬起弩，你已经是目标。
lines.en: I raise the crossbow; you are already the target.

lines.zh: 队伍听我号令，你听弩声。
lines.en: The column obeys me; you obey the crossbow's clack.

lines.zh: 你走进射程，就别怪手稳。
lines.en: You entered my range; do not blame my steady hand.

lines.zh: 我把你写进村里的名单，最上面。
lines.en: I write you at the top of the village list.

lines.zh: 目标确认，先断你的退路。
lines.en: Target confirmed; first I cut off your retreat.

lines.zh: 你身上没有菌，所以先处理你。
lines.en: You carry no fungus, so you are handled first.

lines.zh: 弩弦绷紧，我在心里数三下。
lines.en: The string tightens; I count three in my head.

lines.zh: 开始了，这一场会死很多人。
lines.en: It begins, and many will die in this one.

lines.zh: 我慢慢跟着，等你走出掩体。
lines.en: I follow slowly, waiting for you to leave cover.

lines.zh: 弩口跟着你的肩，一寸一寸。
lines.en: The crossbow tracks your shoulder, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我在算风向，也在算你的步频。
lines.en: I am judging the wind and the rhythm of your steps.

lines.zh: 你躲到柱子后面，我换个角度。
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar; I change my angle.

lines.zh: 我的准星压在你的膝盖上。
lines.en: My sights rest on your knee.

lines.zh: 快速装填让我不必换手。
lines.en: Quick Charge means I never switch hands.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬下巴，召唤物从侧面绕。
lines.en: I jerk my chin and my summons circle around.

lines.zh: 你跑得很快，但跑不出射程。
lines.en: You run well, but you cannot outrun the range.

lines.zh: 我保持这个距离，刚好够你怕。
lines.en: I keep this distance, just enough to frighten you.

lines.zh: 你在喘，我听得十分清楚。
lines.en: You are panting, and I hear it perfectly.

lines.zh: 枪托砸在你肋骨上，一声闷响。
lines.en: The stock slams your ribs with a dull crack.

lines.zh: 我的弩当棍子使，也够重。
lines.en: My crossbow works as a club, and heavy enough.

lines.zh: 我顶开你的盾，膝盖跟上。
lines.en: I shove your shield aside and drive a knee in.

lines.zh: 十二点伤害，我一击算好了。
lines.en: Twelve points of damage; I planned a single blow.

lines.zh: 你抬手去挡，我的护甲撞过去。
lines.en: You raise an arm; my armor crashes through it.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领子把你拎起来。
lines.en: I grab your collar and haul you up.

lines.zh: 贴到这么近，弩反倒碍事。
lines.en: This close, the crossbow only gets in the way.

lines.zh: 我用靴跟碾你的手指。
lines.en: I grind your fingers under my heel.

lines.zh: 你倒下的时候，我按住你的剑。
lines.en: As you fall, I pin your sword down.

lines.zh: 别急着起来，还有第二下。
lines.en: Do not hurry to stand; there is a second hit.

lines.zh: 我从队长的位置上长出来。
lines.en: I grow up out of the captain's place.

lines.zh: 菌染掠夺者的皮还挂在我身上。
lines.en: Infected pillager hide still hangs on me.

lines.zh: 我第一次呼吸，闻到的是火药。
lines.en: My first breath smells of gunpowder.

lines.zh: 弩已经在手里，不用谁来给。
lines.en: The crossbow is already in my hand, given by no one.

lines.zh: 我落地，四周的白丝跟着散开。
lines.en: I land and white threads spread out around me.

lines.zh: 村里的狗先叫，钟才跟上。
lines.en: The village dogs bark first; the bell follows.

lines.zh: 我抬头，认出了这片屋顶。
lines.en: I look up and recognize these rooftops.

lines.zh: 队伍空出的位置由我补上。
lines.en: I fill the gap left in the column.

lines.zh: 我带来的不只是我自己。
lines.en: What I bring is not only myself.

lines.zh: 我站在田埂上，麦子开始发灰。
lines.en: I stand on the ridge and the wheat turns gray.

lines.zh: 第一次拉弦，声音很陌生。
lines.en: The first draw sounds strange to me.

lines.zh: 没人喊过我的名字，先兆已至。
lines.en: No one has named me yet, but the omen is here.

lines.zh: 火燎过菌毯，我身上的白丝蜷了。
lines.en: Flames lick my mat and the white threads curl.

lines.zh: 从屋顶摔下去，我先护住弩。
lines.en: Falling off the roof, I shield the crossbow first.

lines.zh: 水灌进护甲缝，我的低吼成了气泡。
lines.en: Water fills my armor seams and my growl becomes bubbles.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，菌皮烧成焦片。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and scorches my fungal skin.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进我的腿，我拔出来折断。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my leg; I pull it out and snap it.

lines.zh: 魔法的光钻进伤口，菌丝乱跳。
lines.en: Magic light seeps into the wound and my threads spasm.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿只是慢慢变空。
lines.en: I eat nothing; hunger is only slowly going hollow.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，护甲烫得发白。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and my armor glows white hot.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下扯，我还在数箭。
lines.en: The void drags me down and I am still counting bolts.
